title: Ukrainian film-premiere coverage is thin
finding: The audited public film-premiere files contain 36 Ukrainian records versus 744 Czech records. That imbalance makes Ukrainian culture stories research-dependent.

evidence.detail: The audit counted 36 Ukrainian premiere records.
The comparison file contains 744 Czech premiere records.

proposedAction: Owner may commission sourced Ukrainian film-premiere coverage before the product relies on this pillar; the venture must not infer missing premieres.
